invariants: category_id must be a valid existing category ID or None (for new categories)
sku must be unique across all products
price_cents must be a non-negative integer
stock_qty must be a non-negative integer
reorder_threshold must be a non-negative integer if provided
low_active must be a boolean (default False)
category.name must be unique across all categories
stock_qty cannot exceed the maximum allowed stock value (if defined elsewhere; not specified in requirements)
a product's category_id must reference an existing category
a product's stock_qty must not be negative
a product's price_cents must not be negative
low-stock products are those whose stock_qty is strictly below their category's reorder_threshold (if threshold exists; otherwise, no low-stock products exist for that category)
